scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Ah...
Here it is!
scripts.translation:
[凱恩·希梅爾]
啊...
找到了！

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Welcome to the Airship~
If you have questions or
need any assistance, please
don't hesitate to ask me or
any one of the other crewmen.
scripts.translation:
[凱恩·希梅爾]
歡迎來到飛空艇~
如果您有任何問題
或需要協助，請隨時
向我或其他船員詢問。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
A few days ago, a customer
from Einbroch left this on the
Airship. He called and let us
know that he can't come back
to get it, but he is staying
over at the Einbroch Hotel.
scripts.translation:
[凱恩·希梅爾]
幾天前，一位來自
艾音布羅克的顧客
把東西落在了飛空艇上。
他打電話告訴我們，
他無法回來取，
但他住在艾音布羅克酒店。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
I know it's a strange
favor to ask, but would
you deliver this to Defru
Ark at the Einbroch Hotel?
Of course, I'll repay you
upon your return.
scripts.translation:
[凱恩·希梅爾]
我知道這個請求
有點奇怪，但您能
把這個送到艾音布羅克酒店
的Defru Ark那裡嗎？
當然，您回來時
我會報答您的。

scripts.text: ^3355FFKain Himere has given you a small box.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF凱恩·希梅爾給了您一個小盒子。^000000

scripts.text: About the Airship...
scripts.translation: 關於飛空艇...

scripts.text: Leave a Comment
scripts.translation: 留下評論

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Is this your first time flying?
I understand if you feel nervous. Before I worked here, I used to feel the same way. Still, this
Airship is pretty amazing. It's incredible what science can do...
scripts.translation:
[凱恩·希梅爾]
這是您第一次坐飛機嗎？
我理解您可能會感到緊張。在我來這裡工作之前，我也會有同樣的感覺。不過，這架飛空艇真的很驚人。科學的力量真是不可思議...

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
You want to hear more
about the Airship? Hmm,
there's not too much that
I know, but let me see...
scripts.translation:
[凱恩·希梅爾]
您想多瞭解一些
關於飛空艇的事嗎？嗯，
我知道的並不多，
不過讓我想想...

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
I hear from the scholars
who developed the Airship
technology that just a little
piece of the heart of Ymir
generates the power for
this ship to fly. Incredible...
scripts.translation:
[凱恩·希梅爾]
我聽說，開發飛空艇技術的
學者們說，只需要
尤米爾心臟的一小部分，
就能產生讓這艘船
飛行的動力。太不可思議了...

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
You know, scientific research
has made living easier and more
comfortable in the Schwarzwald
Republic, much in the way magic
research has changed life in the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[凱恩·希梅爾]
你知道嗎，科學研究
讓修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國
的生活變得更加便捷和舒適，
就像魔法研究改變了
盧恩·米德加茲王國的生活一樣。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Well, it's rumored that this
really big corporation runs
this Airship. Supposedly,
they've got their hands in
all sorts of enterprises.
scripts.translation:
[凱恩·希梅爾]
嗯，據說有一家
非常大的公司
在運營這架飛空艇。
據說他們涉足
各種各樣的企業。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Since the Airships are our
form of national transportation,
the higher-ups must be making
a ton of money. It's pretty crazy.
scripts.translation:
[凱恩·希梅爾]
既然飛空艇是我們
國家的主要交通工具，
高層肯定賺了很多錢。
真是挺瘋狂的。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
You wish to leave
a comment about our
service? Tell me your
message and I'll report
it to the higher ups.
To cancel, press '0'.
scripts.translation:
[凱恩·希梅爾]
您想對我們的服務
留下評論嗎？請告訴我
您的留言，我會向
上級彙報。
若要取消，請按'0'。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
K-Kafra...?
Hmm, maybe I better
not send this up after all...
scripts.translation:
[凱恩·希梅爾]
卡...卡普拉...？
嗯，也許我最好
還是別把這個
傳上去了...

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Ah, well, if you have any
helpful criticism about our
service, feel free to leave
me a comment at any time.
scripts.translation:
[凱恩·希梅爾]
啊，好吧，如果您
對我們的服務有任何
建設性的批評，
請隨時給我留言。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Hmmmm...
I see. Well, I'll
send your message
to my superiors as
soon as possible.
Thank you very much.
scripts.translation:
[凱恩·希梅爾]
嗯...
我明白了。我會
儘快將您的留言
轉達給我的上級。
非常感謝。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Oh, how are you?
If you don't mind me
asking, where are you
headed this time?
scripts.translation:
[凱恩·希梅爾]
哦，您好嗎？
如果不介意的話，
請問您這次
要去哪裡？

scripts.text: About the Airship...
scripts.translation: 關於飛空艇...

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
You must really want to know all about the Airship, don't you? I'm sorry, but I don't know much more than what I've already told you.
scripts.translation:
[凱恩·希梅爾]
您一定非常想了解飛空艇的一切，對吧？很抱歉，除了我已經告訴您的，我並不知道更多了。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
I guess if you'd want to know more, you should study to become a Sage in Juno and do your own Airship research...
scripts.translation:
[凱恩·希梅爾]
我想，如果您想了解更多，應該去朱諾學習成為賢者，並親自進行飛空艇的研究...

scripts.text: What the hell...?
scripts.translation: 這到底是怎麼回事...？

scripts.text: What's wrong?
scripts.translation: 怎麼了？

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
I-I'm sorry...
That was so
unprofessional.
H-have a safe trip
and th-thank you for
using the Airship! ^333333*Sob*^000000
scripts.translation:
[凱恩·希梅爾]
對...對不起...
那樣做太不
專業了。
祝...祝您旅途
平安，謝...謝謝您
乘坐飛空艇！ ^333333*抽泣*^000000

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
I'm sorry, but it's
a long story. Plus,
you wouldn't understand...
scripts.translation:
[凱恩·希梅爾]
很抱歉，這說來話長。
而且，您也
不會明白的...

scripts.text: I have time for a long story.
scripts.translation: 我有時間聽長故事。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Alright, I might as well get
this off my chest. I guess it
all started when I was a young
man living in Einbech.
scripts.translation:
[凱恩·希梅爾]
好吧，我乾脆
把心裡話說出來吧。我想
一切都要從我年輕時
住在艾音貝赫說起。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Those days, I was pretty hot
headed and short tempered,
but working as a miner used to
always bring me a sense of peace. Staking my life with my friends, mining pick in hand. Yeah...
scripts.translation:
[凱恩·希梅爾]
那時候，我脾氣很
暴躁，容易發火，
但從事礦工工作總
能讓我感到平靜。和朋友們
一起拼上性命，手持礦鎬。是啊...

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
It might have been dangerous,
but it was good, hard and honest work. You know, the mines that connected to the Einbech lode
used to be everything to our little town. But then, things changed...
scripts.translation:
[凱恩·希梅爾]
雖然可能很危險，
但那是好的、辛苦且
誠實的工作。您知道，連線
艾音貝赫礦脈的礦坑
曾是我們小鎮的一切。但後來，情況變了...

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
The factories started popping
up and all the ores were moved
to where the smokestacks never
stopped churning. More miners
started working in the factories and the mines became lonelier...
scripts.translation:
[凱恩·希梅爾]
工廠開始拔地而起，
所有的礦石都被運往
煙囪從未停止冒煙的地方。更多的礦工
開始在工廠工作，礦坑變得
更加寂寞...

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
But I loved working on the
land so much, I kept at it
until the accident happened.
Now I can't use my right arm
the way I used to, so I had to
quit my job as a miner...
scripts.translation:
[凱恩·希梅爾]
但我太熱愛在
大地上工作了，所以我
堅持了下來，直到
事故發生。現在我
無法像以前那樣使用
右臂，所以我不得不
辭去礦工的工作...

scripts.text: I'm sorry to hear that.
scripts.translation: 聽到這個我很遺憾。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Yeah...
I was really devastated
when it happened. Those
were probably the worst
years of my entire life.
scripts.translation:
[凱恩·希梅爾]
是啊...
發生那件事時，我
真的非常痛苦。那
大概是我人生中
最糟糕的幾年。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
I couldn't think about
life without mining and
I just lost all enthusiasm
for life. I developed a drinking problem and started shutting out my family. I was so stupid...
scripts.translation:
[凱恩·希梅爾]
我無法想像
沒有挖礦的生活，
我完全失去了
對生活的熱情。我染上了
酗酒的問題，並開始
疏遠家人。我太愚蠢了...

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
I still can't believe how
supportive my wife was during
those days. Even when I was at
my lowest, she tried to sooth my sorrow and even took on a job
to support me and our daughter.
scripts.translation:
[凱恩·希梅爾]
我至今仍無法相信
我的妻子在那段日子裡
是多麼支援我。即使在我
最落魄的時候，她試圖
撫慰我的悲傷，甚至
找了一份工作來
養活我和女兒。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
^666666*Sob*^000000 It was only after she
died that I realized how much
she must have suffered. To make
matters worse, I had to leave my daughter behind with a neighbor
while I searched for work...
scripts.translation:
[凱恩·希梅爾]
^666666*抽泣*^000000 直到她
去世後，我才意識到
她一定承受了多大的痛苦。更糟糕的是，我不得不
把女兒留在鄰居那裡，
而我四處尋找工作...

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
I spent years wandering
from town to town, living
a pretty wild life until I could pick myself up again. And finally, I became an Airship crewman.
scripts.translation:
[凱恩·希梅爾]
我花了幾年時間
從一個城鎮流浪到另一個城鎮，
過著相當放蕩的生活，
直到我重新振作起來。最後，我
成為了飛空艇的船員。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
It's been twenty years
since I've lost my family.
My daughter is somewhere
out there, but I can't even
remember her name...
scripts.translation:
[凱恩·希梅爾]
距離我失去家人
已經二十年了。
我的女兒在
某個地方，但我甚至
記不起她的名字...

scripts.text: Have you tried looking for her?
scripts.translation: 你試過找她嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
I tried going to the house
where my neighbor had lived,
but they moved out years ago.
I really have no clue where she
could be. But I don't deserve to see her. I was a horrible father!
scripts.translation:
[凱恩·希梅爾]
我試著去
我鄰居住過的房子，
但他們幾年前就搬走了。
我真的不知道她
在哪裡。但我不配
見她。我是個糟糕的父親！

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
^666666*Sob*^000000 I'm sorry you
had to hear all of that,
but I really appreciate that
you've listened to me. Now
tell me, where are you headed?
scripts.translation:
[凱恩·希梅爾]
^666666*抽泣*^000000 很抱歉讓您
聽了這些，
但我真的很感激
您願意聽我傾訴。現在
告訴我，您要去哪裡？

scripts.text: Einbroch
scripts.translation: 艾音布羅克

scripts.text: Juno
scripts.translation: 朱諾

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm heading
to Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我要去艾音布羅克。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Perfect...!
If you don't mind,
would you do a favor
for me? First, let me
find that package...
scripts.translation:
[凱恩·希梅爾]
太好了...！
如果不介意的話，
能幫我個忙嗎？
首先，讓我找找那個包裹...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm heading
to Juno.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我要去朱諾。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Ah, I see...
There was something
I needed sent to Einbroch.
Anyway, have a good trip.
Oh, and thanks for listening.
scripts.translation:
[凱恩·希梅爾]
啊，是嗎...
我本來有東西要寄到艾音布羅克。
總之，祝你旅途愉快。
哦，還有，謝謝你願意聽我傾訴。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Oh hello!
Things are a little
hectic right now, but
did you delive-- Oh!
Wait, excuse me! Sir--!
scripts.translation:
[凱恩·希梅爾]
哦，你好！
現在有點忙，
你是來送...哦！
等等，失禮了！先生--！

scripts.text:
^3355FFKain seems too
busy to speak to
you right now...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF凱恩似乎太忙了，
現在沒法和您對話...^000000

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Welcome back to the Airship. So did you deliver that little box safely?
scripts.translation:
[凱恩·希梅爾]
歡迎回到飛空艇。那個小箱子你安全送出去了嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, unfortunately. He was away when I got there. Let me give this box back to you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，很遺憾。我到的時候他不在。讓我把這個箱子還給您。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Oh...
What should I do now? Oh well, sorry for putting you through so much trouble.
scripts.translation:
[凱恩·希梅爾]
哦...
現在該怎麼辦呢？算了，抱歉給你添了這麼多麻煩。

scripts.text: Casually mention Miner's Song
scripts.translation: 隨意提及礦工之歌

scripts.text: Suavely mention Tarsha
scripts.translation: 優雅地提及塔莎

scripts.text:
[{0}]
While we're on the topic
of boxes and deliveries,
have you ever heard of
the ''Miner's Song?''
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
既然提到了箱子和快遞，
你聽說過''礦工之歌''嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
''Miner's Song...''
I miss singing that
while working the mines.
I used to sing it all the time
when I was younger, actually.
scripts.translation:
[凱恩·希梅爾]
''礦工之歌...''
我懷念在礦裡工作時
唱那首歌的日子。
其實我小時候經常唱。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
I think I sang it so
much, I even got my little
daughter to sing it with me~
(But what was her name?!)
scripts.translation:
[凱恩·希梅爾]
我想我唱得太多，
連我的小女兒都跟著我唱了~
（但她叫什麼名字來著？！）

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^333333*Cough cough*
*Cou--TARSHA--Cough*^000000

[Kain Himere]
What the...?
Wait. T-Tarsha...
Why does it feel like that
name means something?
scripts.translation:
[凱恩·希梅爾]
什麼...？
等等。塔--塔莎...
為什麼這個名字
聽起來很熟悉？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You know...
I met a little girl in Einbroch
who was singing the ''Miner's
Song.'' It seems her mother
Tarsha had taught it to her.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你知道嗎...
我在艾音布羅克遇到一個小女孩，
她在唱''礦工之歌''。
看來是她的母親塔莎教給她的。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Interesting. But usually,
only miners would know 
that song. Does this have
anything to do with me?
scripts.translation:
[凱恩·希梅爾]
有意思。但通常，
只有礦工才會知道
那首歌。這和我
有什麼關係嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, this little girl's mother, Tarsha, learned the song from
her father who might have been
a miner. But he mysteriously
disappeared years ago...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，那個小女孩的母親塔莎，
是從她父親那裡學會這首歌的，
他可能是一名礦工。但他幾年前
神秘地失蹤了...

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Poor girl...!
Her father just
left her?! Why,
she's just like...
scripts.translation:
[凱恩·希梅爾]
可憐的孩子...！
她父親竟然
丟下她走了？天哪，
她簡直就像...

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Wait...
Sweet Christ...
The miner who taught
Tarsha that song might
have been... ^0000FFme^000000.
scripts.translation:
[凱恩·希梅爾]
等等...
天哪...
教塔莎那首歌的礦工，
也許就是... ^0000FF我^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, for now, we can't
be too sure. Do you have
anything that might prove
you're Tarsha's father?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，目前我們還不能確定。
你有什麼能證明
你是塔莎父親的證據嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Ehhmmm...
Before I left own, I buried
some of my stuff underneath
a tree in Einbech. I can't exactly remember where, but my wife's
journal should be there.
scripts.translation:
[凱恩·希梅爾]
呃...
在我離開之前，我把一些東西
埋在了艾音貝赫的一棵樹下。
我不太記得具體位置了，
但我妻子的日記應該在那裡。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Since my wife kept track
of everything in her journal,
she should have written enough
about our daughter for us to know whether or not this Tarsha could be my long lost daughter.
scripts.translation:
[凱恩·希梅爾]
因為我妻子把一切都記錄在日記裡，
她應該寫了很多關於女兒的事，
足以讓我們判斷這個塔莎
是否真的是我失散多年的女兒。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Now, I can't really leave
the Airship, so would you help
me by finding that journal and
seeing if Tarsha is really related to me somehow? I'd be grateful
if you could do that for me...
scripts.translation:
[凱恩·希梅爾]
現在，我實在無法離開飛空艇，
所以你能幫我找到那本日記，
看看塔莎是否真的與我有關嗎？
如果你能幫我這個忙，我將感激不盡...

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Would you find my wife's
journal and see if Tarsha
is really my daughter? The
journal should be buried
underneath a tree in Einbech.
scripts.translation:
[凱恩·希梅爾]
你能找到我妻子的日記，
看看塔莎是否真的是我的女兒嗎？
日記應該埋在艾音貝赫的一棵樹下。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou better fulfill Kain's
request by finding his wife's
journal and confronting Tarsha
before you speak to him again.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你最好先找到他妻子的日記，
並去見見塔莎，
然後再回來找凱恩對話。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou give his wife's
journal to Kain and tell
him that you learn that Tarsha
is really his daughter and that
she is happily married and is
an inventor in Einbroch.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你把妻子的日記交給凱恩，
並告訴他你得知塔莎
真的是他的女兒，
她已婚且生活幸福，
現在是艾音布羅克的一名發明家。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFKain's eyes well
with tears and his
entire body trembles
with unrestrainable joy.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF凱恩熱淚盈眶，
全身因無法抑制的喜悅
而顫抖著。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
She must have
had a hard time...
But she doesn't
hate me at all.
scripts.translation:
[凱恩·希梅爾]
她一定過得很辛苦...
但她一點也不恨我。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Rashelle?
Can you see me?
Can I really be this
happy? I'm so sorry,
my love... ^666666*Sob...*^000000
scripts.translation:
[凱恩·希梅爾]
拉謝爾？
你能看到我嗎？
我真的可以這麼幸福嗎？
對不起，我的愛人... ^666666*啜泣...*^000000

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Thank you for all of
your help, youngster.
And please, take this
as a token of my gratitude.
scripts.translation:
[凱恩·希梅爾]
謝謝你所有的幫助，年輕人。
請收下這個，
作為我的一點心意。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
I know this isn't
much, but please
understand that it's
all I have to give you.
God bless you for all
you've done for me~
scripts.translation:
[凱恩·希梅爾]
我知道這不算什麼，
但請理解，
這是我唯一能給你的了。
上帝保佑你，
謝謝你為我所做的一切~

scripts.text:
^3355FFHmmm...
It would be better
if you approached
Kain with the Doodled
Letter that you received.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF嗯...
如果你帶著收到的塗鴉信件
去找凱恩，情況可能會更好。^000000

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Oh, how are you
lately, my friend?
I've been doing great,
especially since you've
helped me find my daughter.
Enjoy your travels~
scripts.translation:
[凱恩·希梅爾]
哦，最近怎麼樣，我的朋友？
我過得很好，
尤其是你幫我找到了女兒之後。
旅途愉快~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me...?
^3355FFNo one's here!^000000

[{0}]
This must be the room...
But where the hell is he?
I can't just leave this stuff
here if he won't come back.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這應該是他的房間...
但他到底在哪裡？
如果他不會回來，
我不能把這些東西留在這裡。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh well...
I guess I can
just give this
back to Kain
on the Airship.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
算了...
我想我可以把這些東西
帶回飛空艇還給凱恩。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
While I'm in Einbroch,
I may as well take a look
around here and see if I can
find anything interesting. Still, I can't help but think of Kain
Himere's long lost daughter...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
既然我在艾音布羅克，
不妨四處看看，
找找有沒有什麼有趣的東西。
不過，我還是忍不住想起
凱恩·希梅爾失散多年的女兒...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Maybe...
Just maybe...
I can find some
sort of clue about
where she is. She might
even live here in Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
也許...
只是也許...
我能找到一些關於
她下落的線索。
她甚至可能就住在
艾音布羅克。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I think I'll do that.
Maybe even right this
minute. Treat it like
sort of quest or something.
Yeah, that could work.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想我會這麼做。
也許就從現在開始。
把它當成某種任務吧。
嗯，這樣應該可以。

scripts.text:
[Elle Cherno]
Let's get to work
fear-less comraaades~!
Do our best! Nothing
can stop us, lads~!
scripts.translation:
[艾勒·切爾諾]
讓我們開始工作吧，
無所畏懼的同志們~！
加油！沒有什麼能
阻擋我們，夥計們~！

scripts.text: Hello!
scripts.translation: 你好！

scripts.text: What are you singing?
scripts.translation: 你在唱什麼歌？

scripts.text:
[Elle Cherno]
Let's get to work
fear-less comraaades~!
Do our best! Nothing
can stop us, lads~!
scripts.translation:
[艾勒·切爾諾]
讓我們開始工作吧，
無所畏懼的同志們~！
加油！沒有什麼能
阻擋我們，夥計們~！

scripts.text:
[Elle Cherno]
I like this song lots!
Especially when I yell out
''comrades!'' COMRADES!
scripts.translation:
[艾勒·切爾諾]
我很喜歡這首歌！
尤其是當我大聲喊出
“同志們！”的時候。同志們！

scripts.text:
[Elle Cherno]
This...?
It's the ''Miner's Song!''
My mommy taught it to me
and she sings it a lot. Daddy
says it's too noisy, though.
scripts.translation:
[艾勒·切爾諾]
這個...？
這是《礦工之歌》！
是我媽媽教我的，
她經常唱。不過爸爸
說太吵了。

scripts.text:
[Elle Cherno]
Mmm, when my mommy sings
this song, sometimes she looks
a little sad. Jus' today she sang it a little and looked like she was gonna cry. ^666666*Gasp!*^000000 Wait, do you
think maybe Mommy's sick?
scripts.translation:
[艾勒·切爾諾]
嗯，當媽媽唱這首歌時，
她有時候看起來有點難過。
今天她唱了一小段，
看起來快要哭了。^666666*倒吸一口涼氣！*^000000 等等，
你覺得媽媽是不是生病了？

scripts.text:
[Elle Cherno]
Oh no, oh no...
Hey, will you go see
if my mommy's okay for me?
Please? Our house is behind
the Hotel, so tell me if she's
not feeling good, promise?
scripts.translation:
[艾勒·切爾諾]
天哪，天哪...
嘿，你能去看看
我媽媽沒事嗎？
拜託了？我們家在
旅館後面，如果她
感覺不舒服，請告訴我，
好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Elle Cherno]
Our house is right
behind of the Hotel.
Will you go there and
see my mommy for me,
please? I'm worried...
scripts.translation:
[艾勒·切爾諾]
我們家就在
旅館後面。
你能去那裡
看看我媽媽嗎？
拜託了？我很擔心...

scripts.text:
[Elle Cherno]
Hey! I have something
to give you, but you have
tooooo much stuff! Hey,
come back later so I can
give it to you, okay?
scripts.translation:
[艾勒·切爾諾]
嘿！我有東西
要給你，但是你的
東西太多了！嘿，
請稍後再來，這樣我
才能給你，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Elle Cherno]
You saw my grandpa?
You're his friend, right?
A-are you gonna see
him later? 'Cuz... cuz...
scripts.translation:
[艾勒·切爾諾]
你見過我爺爺嗎？
你是他的朋友，對吧？
你...你稍後會去
見他嗎？因為...因為...

scripts.text:
[Elle Cherno]
I made this for him.
I don't know how to write,
but I made Grampa a letter
as best as I can. Will you
promise to give this to him
for me, pleeeeeease?
scripts.translation:
[艾勒·切爾諾]
我給他做了這個。
我不會寫字，
但我盡力給爺爺
寫了一封信。你能
答應把這封信
交給他嗎？拜託了？

scripts.text:
^3355FFElle put a big
doodled message
into your hands.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF艾勒把一封
大大的塗鴉信件
塞進了你的手裡。^000000

scripts.text:
[Theo Cherno]
You're very kind,
adventurer. There
should be more people
in the world like you.
scripts.translation:
[西奧·切爾諾]
你真是個好心人，
冒險者。世界上應該
有更多像你這樣的人。

scripts.text:
[Theo Cherno]
Are you sure
that you can find
Tarsha's father? Oh,
you must be a godsend!
scripts.translation:
[西奧·切爾諾]
你確定你能找到
塔爾莎的父親嗎？哦，
你真是幫了大忙！

scripts.text:
[Theo Cherno]
I'm so happy
for my wife. I....
I don't know how
I can thank you...
scripts.translation:
[西奧·切爾諾]
我為我的妻子感到
高興。我...
我不知道該怎麼
感謝你...

scripts.text:
[Theo Cherno]
Hmm...
Can we talk later?
I'm pretty busy trying
to fix this thing at
the moment.
scripts.translation:
[西奧·切爾諾]
嗯...
我們稍後再談好嗎？
我現在正忙著
修理這個東西。

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
Although most of these
contraptions aren't worth
showing off, we've put a lot
of work in inventing these
machines. So, of course,
they give us pride~
scripts.translation:
[塔爾莎·切爾諾]
雖然這些發明
大多不值得炫耀，
但我們花了很多心思
去發明這些機器。
所以，當然，
它們讓我們感到自豪~

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
Maybe all these little
projects might not be
that impressive, but I like
to think of them as stepping
stones to future achievements.
scripts.translation:
[塔爾莎·切爾諾]
也許這些小小的
專案並不那麼令人印象深刻，
但我喜歡把它們看作
通往未來成就的
墊腳石。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me, ma'am,
but you have a scar
on your shoulder. Is
that from an accident?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打擾一下，女士，
您肩膀上有一道傷疤。
那是意外造成的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
Oh, that's an old
injury that happened
years ago. I suppose
I was quite the trouble
maker to the people
who raised me...
scripts.translation:
[塔爾莎·切爾諾]
哦，那是多年前
留下的舊傷。我想，
對於撫養我長大的人來說，
我大概是個很讓人頭疼的孩子...

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
You see, I lost my parents
when I was very young. It
was only later when I realized
I was raised by foster parents.
I learned that my real mother
died a long time ago...
scripts.translation:
[塔爾莎·切爾諾]
你看，我很小的時候
就失去了父母。後來我才意識到，
我是被養父母撫養長大的。
我得知我的親生母親
早已去世...

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
As for my father, no
one knows if he's dead
or alive. I tried my best
to my foster parents happy,
but I ended up being too rebellious and giving them grief.
scripts.translation:
[塔爾莎·切爾諾]
至於我的父親，
沒人知道他是否還活著。
我盡力想讓養父母開心，
但我最終變得太叛逆，
給他們惹了不少麻煩。

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
I finally left home and
studied mechanics. I met
my husband in school and
it was the greatest thing that
ever happened to me~
scripts.translation:
[塔爾莎·切爾諾]
最後我離開了家，
去學習了機匠技術。我在學校裡
遇到了我的丈夫，
那是我人生中發生過的
最美好的事情~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
By the way, I heard
your daughter singing
some sort of Miner's Song.
Did you teach her that?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
順便問一下，我聽說
您的女兒在唱
某種礦工之歌。
是您教她的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Theo Cherno]
I don't understand
why little Elle likes
such a rowdy, man song.
This is all your fault, Tarsha!
scripts.translation:
[西奧·切爾諾]
我不明白為什麼
小艾勒喜歡
這麼粗獷的男性歌曲。
這都是你的錯，塔爾莎！

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
Oh~hohohoho~
I was too young to
remember it clearly,
but I'm sure my real
father loved that song.
scripts.translation:
[塔爾莎·切爾諾]
哦~呵呵呵~
我當時太小了，
記憶不太清晰，
但我確信我的親生父親
很喜歡那首歌。

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
I barely recall that
he used to sing it while
cleaning our old house.
Yes, I don't remember what
he looked like, but he must
have been a miner at one time.
scripts.translation:
[塔爾莎·切爾諾]
我依稀記得
他以前打掃我們舊房子時
會哼唱這首歌。
是的，我不記得他長什麼樣，
但他一定曾經是一名礦工。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A miner...?
(Wait, that crewman,
Kain Himere! He was
a miner who lost his
daughter! Just maybe...)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
礦工...？
（等等，那個船員，
凱恩·希梅爾！他是一名
失去了女兒的礦工！也許...）

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...!
Tarsha...
Your father
may still be alive!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...！
塔爾莎...
您的父親
可能還活著！

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
...What?
scripts.translation:
[塔爾莎·切爾諾]
...什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I've got to go check
something now, but
hopefully I'll be back
soon with good news!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我現在得去確認
一些事情，但
希望很快就能帶著
好訊息回來！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Tarsha, I know someone
who might be your father!
Just wait for me and hopefully
I'll bring back good news soon!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
塔爾莎，我認識一個人，
他可能是您的父親！
請等我一下，希望我很快
就能帶回好訊息！

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
Oh, welcome back~
So were you able to
bring back good news?
scripts.translation:
[塔爾莎·切爾諾]
哦，歡迎回來~
那麼，您能帶回
好訊息嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why, yes.
Speaking of which,
allow me to... check
something first...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，當然。
說到這個，
請允許我...先檢查
一下...

scripts.text: Check her neck.
scripts.translation: 檢查她的脖子。

scripts.text: Check her hands.
scripts.translation: 檢查她的手。

scripts.text: Check her legs.
scripts.translation: 檢查她的腿。

scripts.text: Check her forehead.
scripts.translation: 檢查她的額頭。

scripts.text:
^3355FFUh oh...
Nothing's there!^000000

[Theo Cherno]
H-how rude!
Touching another
man's wife...?!
scripts.translation:
[西奧·切爾諾]
你...你怎麼這麼無禮！
竟然摸別的男人的妻子...？！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou found
a burn mark on
her hand.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你在她的手上
發現了一道燒傷痕跡。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's it!
Tarsha, your
father's name is
Kain Himere and he's
working on the Airship
as one of the crewmen.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
就是它！
塔爾莎，你父親的名字
是凱恩·希梅爾，他正在
飛空艇上擔任船員之一。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
He misses you
a lot and hopes
that you can forgive
him... Someday.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他非常想念你，
希望你能原諒他...
總有一天。

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
Are...
Are you serious?
My father's alive!
Oh thank god! Thank
you so much, adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[塔爾莎·切爾諾]
你...你是認真的嗎？
我父親還活著！
感謝上帝！太感謝你了，冒險者！

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
...........
So that means, my
real name would be
^3131FFTarsha Himere Cherno^000000.
scripts.translation:
[塔爾莎·切爾諾]
...........
那麼也就是說，我的
真名應該是
^3131FF塔爾莎·希梅爾·切爾諾^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
Oh, you're a godsend!
I'll never forget what you've
done for me! I must repay
you somehow! But all I know
is mechanical engineering...
scripts.translation:
[塔爾莎·切爾諾]
哎呀，你真是幫了大忙！
我永遠不會忘記你為我做的一切！
我一定要報答你！但我懂的
只有機械工程...

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
Oh, I know~
If you have any
^3131FFbroken equipment^000000,
I can fix it with this
Expert Repairman. It's
one of our best inventions!
scripts.translation:
[塔爾莎·切爾諾]
哦，我知道了~
如果你有任何
^3131FF損壞的裝備^000000，
我可以用這個
專業修理工來修理它。這是
我們最好的發明之一！

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
I must go and see
my real father soon!
I've missed him for years!
Thank you again for all
you've done for my family~
scripts.translation:
[塔爾莎·切爾諾]
我必須儘快去見
我真正的父親！
我已經好幾年沒見他了！
再次感謝你對我們
全家所做的一切~

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
Oh, and before you
go, would you go see
Elle again? She wanted to
talk to you for some reason.
scripts.translation:
[塔爾莎·切爾諾]
哦，在你走之前，
你能再去見艾勒一次嗎？
她似乎想和你談談。

scripts.text:
^3355FFUh oh...
Nothing's there!^000000

[Theo Cherno]
H-how rude!
Touching another
man's wife...?!
scripts.translation:
[西奧·切爾諾]
你...你怎麼這麼無禮！
竟然摸別的男人的妻子...？！

scripts.text:
^3355FFUh oh...
Nothing's there!^000000

[Theo Cherno]
H-how rude!
Touching another
man's wife...?!
scripts.translation:
[西奧·切爾諾]
你...你怎麼這麼無禮！
竟然摸別的男人的妻子...？！

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
I've been feeling great
after all you've done for
us. Once again, I'd like to
thank you, kind adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[塔爾莎·切爾諾]
在你為我們做了這麼多之後，
我感覺好多了。再次，
我想謝謝你，善良的冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
I'm sorry, but
we're pretty busy.
Please excuse us~
scripts.translation:
[塔爾莎·切爾諾]
抱歉，但我們
現在很忙。
請原諒我們~

scripts.text:
[Theo Cherno]
Honey...
I think there's
a critical structural
problem with the joint.
scripts.translation:
[西奧·切爾諾]
親愛的...
我覺得連線處
有嚴重的結構問題。

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
They must not
be connected right.
Maybe if we... Hmmm.
scripts.translation:
[塔爾莎·切爾諾]
它們肯定沒有
連線好。
也許如果我們...嗯。

scripts.text:
[Theo Cherno]
Well, let's call
it a day and finish
this tomorrow, yeah?
scripts.translation:
[西奧·切爾諾]
好了，今天就
到此為止，明天
再完成它，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
Oh~
I didn't know we
had a guest. Hello,
how are you doing?
Are you interested in
any of our inventions?
scripts.translation:
[塔爾莎·切爾諾]
哦~
我不知道我們有
客人。你好，
你最近怎麼樣？
你對我們的發明
感興趣嗎？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼。

scripts.text: Your daughter asked me to visit you.
scripts.translation: 你女兒讓我來拜訪你。

scripts.text:
[Theo Cherno]
Oh yes, my wife are
I are keeping ourselves
busy by conducting research.
We're trying to invent new
things for better living.
It's what we do...
scripts.translation:
[西奧·切爾諾]
是的，我和妻子正忙著做研究。
我們試圖發明一些能讓生活變得更好的新東西。
這就是我們的工作...

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
Hahaha, Elle?
Why would our
daughter send
you to visit us?
scripts.translation:
[塔爾莎·切爾諾]
哈哈，艾勒？
她為什麼會派你
來拜訪我們呢？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, uh...
She wanted me to
check if her mom
was sick or sad
...Or something?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，那個...
她讓我來看看
她媽媽是不是生病了，
或者心情不好
...之類的？

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
Oh my god...!
What is she thinking?
I apologize for troubling
you over this kind of silly
mistake, adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[塔爾莎·切爾諾]
天哪...！
她在想什麼呢？
很抱歉讓您為這種
愚蠢的誤會
感到困擾，冒險者！

scripts.text:
[Theo Cherno]
But wait, darling.
I agree that sometimes
you look like the loneliest
person in the world, gazing
out that window with those
impossibly wistful eyes.
scripts.translation:
[西奧·切爾諾]
但是等等，親愛的。
我承認，有時候
你看起來像是世界上最孤獨的人，
凝視著窗外，
用那雙充滿渴望的眼睛。

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
Oh, I must be
making my family
very anxious. But
don't you worry, love.
I'm very happy with
you and Elle.
scripts.translation:
[塔爾莎·切爾諾]
哦，我一定是
讓家人很擔心了。
但別擔心，親愛的。
和你和艾勒在一起，
我很幸福。

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
And...
Kind adventurer,
may I ask your name?
scripts.translation:
[塔爾莎·切爾諾]
還有...
善良的冒險者，
我可以問一下您的名字嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am called,
{1}.

[Tarsha Cherno]
{0},
I appreciate your
concern for us. Would
you stay for a cup of tea?
scripts.translation:
[塔爾莎·切爾諾]
{0}，
感謝您的關心。
您願意留下來喝杯茶嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
Now, please pardon the
mess. My husband and I are
mechanical engineers focused
on creating machines that would
reduce the risk of mining ores.
scripts.translation:
[塔爾莎·切爾諾]
請原諒這裡的凌亂。
我和丈夫是機械工程師，
專注於製造能
降低採礦風險的機器。

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
Since we work at home, we
can't avoid having machine
parts lying here and there
sometimes. In any case, we're
hoping we create a machine that could make miners' lives safer...
scripts.translation:
[塔爾莎·切爾諾]
因為我們在家裡工作，
難免會有機器零件
散落各處。總之，
我們希望製造出
能讓礦工生活更安全的機器...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah...
So that's why
there's so many
interesting things
in your house...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊...
原來這就是為什麼
你家裡有這麼多
有趣的東西...

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou begin to
take a look around
the Cherno household.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你開始
四處看看
切爾諾家的情況。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's...
It's a really
strange looking
machine. Does it
even do anything?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這是...
一臺看起來很奇怪的
機器。它甚至
能做什麼嗎？^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's a mirror.
So, of course the
first thing you'll
see is yourself.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這是一面鏡子。
所以，你首先
看到的當然是
你自己。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh wow...
I look pretty good.
No wait. Really, really
good. So this must be
why I get such great
service at restaurants...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哇...
我看起來很不錯。
不，等等。真的，
非常非常好看。這一定
就是為什麼我在餐廳
能得到這麼好的服務...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Man...
I didn't know
I was so good
looking! Ooh yah~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
天哪...
我都不知道
自己這麼帥！
哦耶~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Whoa...
So that's why the
ladies keep looking
at me. I'm a walking
free gun show!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哇...
原來這就是為什麼
女士們總是盯著我看。
我簡直就是一座
行走的免費槍展！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It's a shame I can't job
change to Male Model.
Clearly, I'd be like, Job
Level 87 or something.
Man, I'm beautiful...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
可惜我不能轉職
成男模。
顯然，我會是
87級左右的職業。
天哪，我真美...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This is my reflection?!
No one can be this good
looking, not without special
effects! I mean, it's not
fair to everyone else...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這是我的倒影嗎？！
沒有人能長得這麼好看，
除非有特效！我是說，
這對其他人來說
不公平...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh. Wow.
I never realized...
Everything is in
perfect proportion!
No wonder people
want to party with me~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦。哇。
我從來沒意識到...
我的比例竟然如此完美！
難怪大家都想和我組隊~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh my gosh~
How can I look this
good without any makeup?
I-It isn't fair to all the other
girls... Wow, is this really me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
天哪~
我明明沒化妝，
怎麼能這麼好看？
這...這對其他女生來說不公平...哇，這真的是我嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Am I going crazy?
Is that girl in the
mirror really me...?
How did I not realize
how gorgeous I look?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我瘋了嗎？
鏡子裡那個女孩
真的是我嗎...？
我怎麼會沒發現自己
長得這麼迷人呢？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So...
What did you do with
this mirror? Because I'm
looking at my reflection
and I can't seem to find
any flaws with my figure...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那麼...
你對這面鏡子做了什麼？
因為我看著我的倒影，
完全找不到我身材的缺點...

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
Actually...
That's not one
of our inventions.
It's just a normal mirror...
scripts.translation:
[塔爾莎·切爾諾]
其實...
那並不是
我們的發明。
它只是一面普通的鏡子...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well now...!
Are you sure?
Because my face looks
freakin' immaculate! And
it's like, I'm almost too sexy!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哎呀...！
你確定嗎？
因為我的臉看起來
簡直完美無瑕！而且
我簡直性感得過頭了！

scripts.text:
^3355FFAfter enjoying that
little epiphany, you
see a reflection of
Tarsha's neck as you
set the mirror back down.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF在享受完這小小的頓悟後，
當你把鏡子放回去時，
你看到了塔爾莎脖子的倒影。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAs you take a closer
look, you find that there's
a strange mark around her
neck. What ever could it mean?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF當你湊近細看時，
發現她脖子上有一個奇怪的印記。
那究竟意味著什麼？^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou crouch down
under the tree and
begin digging into
the ground.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你蹲在樹下，
開始挖掘地面。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355ffUnfortunately,
you weren't able
to find anything.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355ff很遺憾，
你什麼也沒找到。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou have found a journal
among some other articles
that have been buried by Kain.
You open the journal and begin
to read what's written inside.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你在被凱恩埋藏的物品中
找到了一本日記。
你開啟日記，開始閱讀裡面的內容。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFThat was the last page of the journal. You picked it up so that you can bring it over to ^3131FFTarsha.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF那是日記的最後一頁。你把它拿起來，
準備帶給^3131FF塔爾莎。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou open
the journal
and begin to read...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你開啟
日記
開始閱讀...^000000

scripts.text:
<Date : OX OX>
^856363I'm sooo happy
to be with Kain.
He's such an honest,
sincere man, even if
he is quiet sometimes.
scripts.translation:
<日期 : OX OX>
^856363能和凱恩在一起，
我真的太開心了。
他是個誠實、
真誠的男人，雖然
有時候有點沉默。

scripts.text:
^856363Although he's a very
good husband to me,
I'm not so good at being
a housewife. But I'll do
my very best for us both.
scripts.translation:
^856363雖然他是我的好丈夫，
但我並不擅長做家庭主婦。不過我會
為我們倆盡我最大的努力。

scripts.text:
<Date : OX OX>
^856363I fell asleep while
fixing dinner and burned
all the food. How can I be
so careless? But Kain ate
every bite, even if he had
to pretend that he liked it.^000000
scripts.translation:
<日期 : OX OX>
^856363我在做晚飯時睡著了，
把食物全燒焦了。我怎麼會
這麼粗心？但凱恩還是
把每一口都吃光了，即使他
不得不假裝自己喜歡。^000000

scripts.text:
<Date : OX OX>
^856363Kain and I will be having
a child soon! I'm so happy,
but I'm also a little worried
sometimes. Kain is all smiles
though, and he gives me relief.^000000
scripts.translation:
<日期 : OX OX>
^856363凱恩和我很快
就要有孩子了！我很開心，
但有時候也有點擔心。不過凱恩
總是面帶微笑，
讓我感到安心。^000000

scripts.text:
<Date : OX OX>
^856363More people have been
leaving the mines to work
for the new factories, many
of them Kain's friends. I think
Kain's pride was pretty hurt.
I wonder how I can help him?^000000
scripts.translation:
<日期 : OX OX>
^856363越來越多的人
離開礦山去新工廠工作，
其中很多是凱恩的朋友。我想
凱恩的自尊心受挫了。
我該怎麼幫他呢？^000000

scripts.text:
<Date : OX OX>
^856363Kain and I are now the
proud parents of a beautiful
baby girl. We named her ^000000Tarsha^856363
and she has her father's eyes.
I'm going to be the best mother
that I can possibly be for her.
scripts.translation:
<日期 : OX OX>
^856363凱恩和我現在成為了
一個漂亮女嬰的父母。
我們給她取名^000000塔爾莎^856363
她有著像父親一樣的眼睛。
我要做我能做到的
最好的母親。

scripts.text:
<Date : OX OX>
^856363Tarsha called me
''Mommy'' for the first
time! It's a miracle!
I want nothing else in
the world but for her to
be happy and healthy.^000000
scripts.translation:
<日期 : OX OX>
^856363塔爾莎第一次
叫我''媽媽''了！
這是奇蹟！
我別無他求，
只希望她能快樂健康。^000000

scripts.text:
<Date : OX OX>
^856363Kain got into an accident
at the mine. While they were
digging ores, toxic gas was
released somehow. It wasn't
lethal, but Kain's arm has
been partly paralyzed...^000000
scripts.translation:
<日期 : OX OX>
^856363凱恩在礦場出了事故。
他們在挖掘礦石時，不知怎的
洩漏了有毒瓦斯。雖然不致命，
但凱恩的手臂部分癱瘓了...^000000

scripts.text:
^856363When the doctor said that
it may even affect his memories
later, he became so depressed.
I tried to make him feel better
by making his favorite soup.
He smiled, but I could tell...^000000
scripts.translation:
^856363當醫生說這甚至可能
影響他的記憶時，他變得非常沮喪。
我試著做他最喜歡的湯
讓他心情好點。他笑了，
但我看得出來...^000000

scripts.text:
^856363I could tell he's
not alright with this.
I hope he feels better
soon. His despair is
at least as great as his
passion for his job.^000000
scripts.translation:
^856363我能感覺到
他對此並不滿意。
希望他早日康復。
他的絕望至少和他
對工作的熱情一樣強烈。^000000

scripts.text:
<Date : OX OX>
^856363Kain's drinking is
getting worse. He comes
home too often screaming
and yelling. There's too
much anger in him and he's
not the same anymore...
scripts.translation:
<日期 : OX OX>
^856363凱恩的酗酒越來越嚴重了。
他回家時經常大喊大叫。
他充滿了憤怒，
已經不再是以前那個他了...

scripts.text:
<Date : OX OX>
^856363Tarsha got her hand
scalded from boiling
water while playing in
the kitchen. Although she
was treated, she'll always
have that ^000000burn mark^856363.^000000
scripts.translation:
<日期 : OX OX>
^856363塔爾莎在廚房玩耍時，
被開水燙傷了手。雖然治療了，
但她手上永遠會留下^000000燒傷疤痕^856363。^000000

scripts.text:
^856363After we got home from
the doctor's, Tarsha laughed
and played with her doll as if
nothing ever happened. But for
some reason, I couldn't stop
myself from crying...^000000
scripts.translation:
^856363從醫生那裡回家後，
塔爾莎笑著玩她的娃娃，
好像什麼都沒發生過一樣。
但不知為何，
我忍不住哭了起來...^000000

scripts.text:
<Date : OX OX>
^856363Kain comes home less
nowadays. I've had to
start working in the store
after we spent all of our
savings. It's tough working
and taking care of the family.
scripts.translation:
<日期 : OX OX>
^856363最近凱恩回家的次數變少了。
我們用光了積蓄，
所以我不得不在店裡工作。
一邊工作一邊照顧家庭，
真的很辛苦。

scripts.text:
^856363Still, it's all worth
it to see Tarsha's smile.
But I can never stop worrying
about my poor, dear Kain...
scripts.translation:
^856363不過，看到塔爾莎的笑容，
一切都值得了。
但我總是無法停止
為我可憐又親愛的凱恩擔心...

scripts.text:
<Date : OX OX>
^856363Everyday, I feel weaker
and weaker, as if I die
just a little more each day.
I wanted to tell Kain about
what the doctor said, but he's
not ready for this news yet...^000000
scripts.translation:
<日期 : OX OX>
^856363每一天，我都感覺更虛弱，
彷彿每天都在一點點死去。
我想告訴凱恩醫生說的話，
但他還沒準備好接受這個訊息...^000000

scripts.text:
^856363Lately, Tarsha cries
a lot. My poor baby loves
her father, but he's always
so distant. But sometimes,
I see him sadly smile for
Tarsha, if only for a moment.^000000
scripts.translation:
^856363最近，塔爾莎經常哭。
我可憐的孩子愛她的父親，
但他總是那麼疏遠。但有時候，
我會看到他為了塔爾莎
悲傷地微笑，哪怕只是一瞬間。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This is the
^FF0000Expert Repairman^000000?!
It looks like it
needs repairs itself...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這就是
^FF0000專家修理工^000000？！
看起來它自己
都需要修理了...
